title: What happens if you crack your knuckles every day?
sources: Harvard Health Publishing, Does Knuckle Cracking Cause Arthritis?

lines.text: Does cracking your knuckles every single day really cause crippling arthritis like your parents claimed?
Science has tested this extensively, and the answer is an absolute myth.
lines.caps: Science proves that | this warning is a *myth!

lines.text: Your finger joints are surrounded by a lubricating fluid called synovial fluid.
When you stretch or bend the joint, you create sudden negative pressure inside the capsule.
This vacuum causes dissolved nitrogen gas to form microscopic bubbles that instantly collapse with a loud pop.
One famous doctor cracked only the knuckles on his left hand for sixty years, proving zero arthritis occurred.
lines.caps: One doctor cracked *one hand | for 60 years | with *zero damage!

lines.text: So crack your knuckles freely—it might annoy your friends, but your joints are safe.
lines.caps: It won't cause *arthritis | but it might *annoy friends!
